CFML Language Reference: Functions

Hash

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Converts a string into a 32-character hexadecimal MD5 hash. The same input always gives the same hash, but the original string cannot be recovered from it.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Hash(string)

Parameters

string
The string to hash.

Returns

A string of 32 uppercase hexadecimal characters.

Usage

Store Hash(Form.Password) in your database instead of the password itself. To check a login, hash what the user typed and compare the two hashes. Even if someone walks off with your database on a Zip disk, the passwords stay secret.

Hashes are case-sensitive in what they digest: "Secret" and "secret" give completely different results.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Words = "password,Password,KoldFusion">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>Hash()</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Words#" INDEX="w">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#w#</TD><TD><TT>#Hash(w)#</TT></TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFIF Hash("password") EQ "5F4DCC3B5AA765D61D8327DEB882CF99"><P>Password accepted.</P></CFIF>
